exposure: Male small for gestational age fetuses
outcome: Rupture of membranes (ROM) prior to delivery
Nonreassuring fetal heart rate during labor
Neonatal Apgar scores at 1 minute and 5 minutes
cohort: 1749 women with singleton pregnancies planning a vaginal delivery.
finding: Nuchal cord was associated with increased risks of ROM prior to delivery, need for labor augmentation, prolonged second stage of labor, nonreassuring fetal heart rate during labor, and instrumental/cesarean delivery.
